newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P puts Orix on CreditWatch, negative implications.
newsitem.headline: S&P puts Orix on CreditWatch, negative implications.

text.p: Standard & Poors Corp (S&P) said on Wednesday that it had placed its BBB long-term counterparty rating for Orix Corp and its affiliates on CreditWatch with negative implications.
The action reflects Orix's planned acquisition of 310 billion yen in leases, installment sales contracts and loan-asset receivables from Crown Leasing Corp's domestic portfolio, S&P said.
Crown Leasing, one of the three financial affiliates of Nippon Credit Bank Ltd, went bankrupt in April due to asset-quality problems.
Ratings placed on CreditWatch are Orix and Orix Ireland Finance Plc and Orix (Caribbean) NV, S&P said.
S&P will resolve the CreditWatch action after meeting with Orix's management regarding the acquisition and determining the impact on the company's financial performance.
